mentions.h: BILL LUCAS "... a bold spirit in a loyal breast"

photos.c: Blackheath's 31 year old Sydney Wooderson, a comparative novice at 3 miles, leads the Dutchman Willie Slykhuis on his way to victory in the 1946 AAA Championships in a British Record time of 13:53.2.
